title: Nutty and Crispy Uruguayan Grape Leaves Empanada
description: A unique and flavorful Uruguayan dish featuring crispy empanadas stuffed with a savory mixture of onions, garlic, almonds, and grape leaves, served with a side of tangy aji sauce.
instructions: Prepare the grape leaf filling: In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped almonds and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the grape leaves and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the empanada dough: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, melted shortening, and water. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 12-15 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tbsp of the grape leaf filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with egg wash and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
